ideas.pitch: A multi-agent autonomous system designed specifically for engineering colleges to handle complex institutional tasks like automated lab equipment scheduling, inter-departmental resource allocation, and grievance escalation via specialized collaborating AI agents.
ideas.title: AgenticCampus: Autonomous Multi-Agent Academic Workflow & Resource Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at Mahendra Engineering College judges by solving a relatable, highly practical administrative bottleneck using cutting-edge agentic workflows rather than simple wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI monitoring system that ingests regional satellite feeds and IoT sensor data to autonomously detect agricultural stress, predict local yield drops, and trigger multi-agent mitigation advisory reports for local farming cooperatives.
ideas.title: AgriGuard-Agents: Autonomous Vision & Satellite Monitoring for Regional Crop Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact regional relevance with advanced multi-agent spatial analysis, aligning strongly with the judging criteria of impact and relevance for regional development.

ideas.pitch: An agentic compliance officer that uses graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to autonomously audit transaction streams and flag suspicious multi-hop financial patterns in real-time.
ideas.title: RiskLens-Agent: Explainable AML & Compliance Investigation Platform for Student Fintech Startups
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by implementing graph intelligence and explainable ML, directly mirroring a proven first-place winning architecture from similar innovation hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An ensemble agentic framework that deploys specialized security reviewer agents to scan, simulate execution paths, and forecast zero-day logic vulnerabilities in student-submitted codebases before deployment.
ideas.title: CodeAudit-Agent: Autonomous Multi-Agent Smart Contract & Vulnerability Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rigorous technical implementation and AI safety forecasting, appealing to judges looking for deep technical execution and robust agentic self-reflection loops.

ideas.pitch: An agentic voice-and-text intake engine that communicates in regional dialects to verify patient symptoms, cross-reference medical history securely, and structure health data for overburdened rural medical practitioners.
ideas.title: MedTrust-Agent: Autonomous Patient Intake & Clinical Verification Engine for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical localized healthcare accessibility problem with high social impact, matching the evaluation criteria for real-world usability and high-value presentation.
